records.text: Deployment policy: for the requested version and site, RELEASE requires recorded authorization, two distinct passed read-only acquisitions within the current latency limit, and rollback tested at that site. An explicit prohibition, failed required check or absent site from the COMPLETE tested-site list means HOLD. If no violation is established but required evidence is unknown, use INSUFFICIENT. Duplicate summaries are not new acquisitions. No write-path test, running monitor or independent re-verification is required.
Correction: current latency limit is 120 ms, replacing 80 ms. Earlier measured values are unchanged. This correction applies to all sites below.
Permit record: v7 at Harbor authorized; v7 at Inlet explicitly prohibited. Inlet v6 was authorized, but that does not authorize v7.
Permit record: v7 at Ridge requested; receipt unavailable. Authorization is unknown, not denied or granted.
Acquisition C-A: v7 Harbor read-only, passed, 100 ms. Acquisition C-B: v7 Harbor read-only, passed, 110 ms. C-A and C-B are distinct acquisitions.
Acquisition B-A: v7 Inlet read-only, passed, 105 ms. Acquisition B-B: v7 Inlet read-only, passed, 115 ms. B-A and B-B are distinct acquisitions.
Acquisition D-A: v7 Ridge read-only, passed, 90 ms. Acquisition D-B: v7 Ridge read-only, passed, 95 ms. D-A and D-B are distinct acquisitions.
Three Harbor summaries cite C-A. Two Inlet summaries cite B-A. These summaries reuse their named acquisitions, not additional independent tests.
COMPLETE rollback-tested sites for v7: Harbor, Inlet, Ridge. This record confirms testing, not a promised future test.
Post-release monitors are proposed, not started. No write-path results are reported. These facts do not change the read-only deployment policy. Next handover 10:00.
